verdict.rationale: Keycloak ships hosted login/registration/account-management pages out of the box (getting-started flow, self-registration, forgot password, account console for profile/2FA management) plus themeable customization for look-and-feel, covering sign-in, sign-up, and profile management end to end. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of theme customization workflow in practice, and no evidence of embeddable prebuilt UI components (e.g., React/JS widgets) beyond hosted pages and theme templates.
